e-4, degenerate), and an exp(-A) damping on the negative term (1.6e-4) all fitted worse. Adding a third term hit the 10-parameter limit and did not improve on the two-term form (4.9e-5).

The residual is largest for t < 2 at high A, which points to the positive term's time or A dependence being off.
